findings.auditor_note: Quarterly access reviews were not completed for the Q1 2023 period.
Management did not perform required user access reviews during the audit period.
Annual vendor risk assessments were not completed for three critical vendors.
Critical vulnerabilities identified in external penetration test were not remediated within the SLA.
Several production changes lacked documented approval and testing evidence.
Change management process was bypassed for emergency fixes without retrospective approval.

controls.name: Logical Access Provisioning
controls.description: Logical access to the system is provisioned based on role and least privilege principles.

controls.name: User Access Reviews
controls.description: User access rights are reviewed periodically to ensure appropriate access is maintained.

controls.name: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and remediated in a timely manner.

controls.name: Anomaly Monitoring
controls.description: System anomalies are monitored, logged, and investigated to prevent security incidents.

controls.name: Change Management
controls.description: Changes to systems and applications are authorized, tested, and documented prior to deployment.

controls.name: Vendor Risk Management
controls.description: Risks associated with third-party vendors are assessed and monitored on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: Backup Restore Test
controls.description: Backup recovery tests are performed periodically to verify data can be restored.

controls.name: Logical Access Security
controls.description: Security measures are implemented to protect logical access to the system.

controls.name: End User Device Security
controls.description: End-user devices are secured using MDM, disk encryption, and endpoint protection.

controls.name: Physical Access
controls.description: Physical access to sensitive facilities is restricted and monitored.

controls.name: System Access Revocation
controls.description: Access to systems is revoked in a timely manner when an employee departs.

controls.name: Environmental Protections
controls.description: Data centers have environmental controls like temperature, fire suppression, and power backups.

policy_changes.description: Access Review Policy v3 was enacted, increasing required frequency of user access reviews to monthly.

org_events.description: The platform team was reorganized and three admins (Michael Chen, Sarah Jenkins, David Smith) left.
